title: Vambo AI Releases MORENA, a 1.5B Open-Weight Model Trained From Scratch for 12 African Languages
key_facts: South African startup Vambo AI has released MORENA, an open-weight 1.5-billion-parameter language model trained from scratch for 12 African languages plus English and French.
The 12 languages are ChiShona, Kiswahili, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, isiZulu, isiXhosa, Kinyarwanda, Setswana, Afrikaans, isiNdebele and Nigerian Pidgin.
Co-founder Isheanesu Misi calls it the largest open African AI model trained from scratch and says it outperforms a Google model eight times its size on African text modelling.
iAfrica notes that no benchmark is named, the Google model is not identified and no results have been published, so this is Misi's claim, not a demonstrated finding.
Misi says the model breaks African-language text into units (tokens) more efficiently, making it cheaper to run and to adapt.
Vambo recommends fine-tuning rather than direct deployment; the model is positioned as a base for others to build on.
No licence terms, download location, training data provenance, compute budget or funding details are given.
Vambo AI was founded in April 2023 by Chido Dzinotyiwei and Isheanesu Misi.
